name: FreightTerms
description: Incoterms 2020 rule agreed for a shipment, deciding who pays freight and carries the risk.

members.name: FreeCarrier
members.description: Seller hands the goods to the buyer's carrier.

members.name: FreeOnBoard
members.description: Seller loads the goods on the vessel.

members.name: CarriagePaidTo
members.description: Seller pays carriage to the named place.

members.name: DeliveredAtPlace
members.description: Seller delivers to the named place, unloaded by the buyer.

members.name: DeliveredDutyPaid
members.description: Seller delivers cleared for import, duties paid.
